title: Time Travel Inspector for application snapshots
description: Replay application state with a synchronized timeline, JSON diffs, bookmarks, and custom visual previews backed by checkpoints and incremental changes.

twitter.title: Time Travel Inspector · Zentauri UI
twitter.description: Scrub, compare, bookmark, and render historical application state.

intro: Move through application snapshots and see exactly what changed. A synchronized scrubber, state viewer, and custom renderer keep each historical moment in context.
useCases: Replay a checkout session to inspect when a cart total changed.
Compare editor or workflow state before and after an action.
Bookmark important events during a debugging session.

faqs.question: How are snapshots stored?
faqs.answer: Use createTimeTravelHistory to compact JSON captures into periodic checkpoints and incremental key changes, or supply checkpoints and deltas directly. Each seek starts at the nearest checkpoint.

faqs.question: Can I render my own historical UI?
faqs.answer: Yes. renderPreview receives the selected state, event, comparison state, and changes. onOpenState lets your application open a historical view.

faqs.question: Does this record my application automatically?
faqs.answer: No. Your application owns capture, persistence, and restoration. The inspector displays the immutable history you supply.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: TimeTravelInspector combines a keyboard-accessible timeline, bookmarks, timestamp comparison, state differences, and an optional custom preview.
